item: Prometheus SLI recording and gateway burn-rate alert drill
not_an_slo_measurement: This verifies metric labels, PromQL evaluation, and alert state transitions under synthetic local traffic. It is not production traffic and is not an observed SLO track record.
topology: single local gateway/search/catalog JVMs with disposable PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Redis, embedding, and Prometheus containers
defects_found_and_fixed: No 5xx metric series exists before the first error, so the error, availability, and budget recordings were empty on a healthy system. The error expressions now preserve vector(0).
The gateway search fallback returned 200 with an empty result set, hiding dependency failure from both shoppers and the 5xx SLI. It now returns 503 and has a regression test.

fault_injection.recovery: Search resumed with SIGCONT; the next gateway probe returned 200 without restarting either service.

validation: promtool check rules: SUCCESS, 18 rules found
limits: No alert was delivered to a pager.
The injected outage and traffic were synthetic and local.
The 30-day recording had minutes of local samples, not a 30-day observation.
